3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The morning sun streamed through the windows of my chambers as I slowly opened my eyes.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: Lucita was standing by the bedside. She had an unusually intense expression on her face.

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "Can't we sleep in a little longer? It's not like I have a government to run anymore."

14.speaker: Player_Romus
14.text: "Can't we sleep in a little longer?"

17.speaker: Lucita Azaro
17.text: "There's something I need to tell you."

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: "What do you mean, you *think*? Haven't you been to the doctor yet?"

24.speaker: Lucita Azaro
24.text: "I don't know. I don't even know how far along I am."

25.speaker: Lucita Azaro
25.text: "We shouldn't celebrate yet. Nothing is certain."

31.speaker: Lucita Azaro
31.text: "And with everything that's happened to Her Highness-- Vina..."

32.speaker: Lucita Azaro
32.text: "Time's been a blur since the war began. I thought I was throwing up from nerves."

37.speaker: Lucita Azaro
37.text: "I wasn't even sure how you would take the news."
37.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Diplomatic"] == false) == false)

41.speaker: Lucita Azaro
41.text: "We've had so many security issues lately. I thought I was throwing up from nerves."
41.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_ArmedResistance"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Interfere_Army"] == true) == false)

45.speaker: Lucita Azaro
45.text: "And then after everything with the General-- Father..."
45.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == true)

49.speaker: Lucita Azaro
49.text: "Our overthrow in Zille was such a blur. I thought I was throwing up from nerves."
49.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_ArmedResistance"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Interfere_Army"] == true)

50.speaker: Lucita Azaro
50.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_ArmedResistance"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Interfere_Army"] == true) == false)

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: She hesitantly took my hand, resting the other on her abdomen.

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "From a purely pragmatic point of view, this is perfect. I need a new successor now that Vina is gone."

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "An heir and a spare. Just like I always wanted."

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "You needn't have worried, my love. I'm the happiest man in the world right now."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "We have a challenging time ahead of us, that's for certain."

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "A new heir for our holy kingdom. God has truly smiled upon us this day."

61.speaker: Narrator
61.text: She smiled and wrapped her arms around me.

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: A puzzled frown formed on her face.

65.speaker: Lucita Azaro
65.text: "Whatever happens, we'll remember her. But we're bringing new life into the world."

78.speaker: Player_Romus
78.text: "And you'd never, ever do anything to betray me, right?"

79.speaker: Lucita Azaro
79.text: "Will you come with me to the Palace doctors? I've put this off for long enough."

80.speaker: Narrator
80.text: She kissed me on the forehead.

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "Wait. I want to tell Pabel first."

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "Of course. What are we waiting for?"

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "What do I tell Vina? Her inheritance might be at stake."

88.speaker: Lucita Azaro
88.text: "It'll still be a while before we find out the sex. If it's a boy, I'm sure you'll find a way to let Her Highness down easily."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "First things first. Titus! Get in here! I'm going to be a father again!"
89.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Titus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == false

91.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
91.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Titus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == false

92.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
92.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Titus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == false) == false

93.speaker: Narrator
93.text: My bodyguard entered the room. He cast an eye over myself and Lucita, then reached out to shake my hand.

95.speaker: Titus Gordion
95.text: "Congratulations, my king. You must be very proud."

96.speaker: Narrator
96.text: I summoned my butler. He cautiously regarded myself and Lucita as he stood in the doorway of my chambers.

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "Pabel! I'm going to be a father again!"

102.speaker: Player_Romus
102.text: "Lucita and I were married in secret, and now she's having my baby."

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "From now on, you're going to be butlering for three. King, queen and unborn heir."

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "Duchess Azaro and I are with child. You shall congratulate us at once."

106.speaker: Narrator
106.text: A series of emotions passed across his face as he absorbed this news. Finally, he reached out to shake my hand.

107.speaker: Pabel Adria
107.text: "Congratulations to you both. You must be very proud."

108.speaker: Player_Romus
108.text: "As a gesture of gratitude for your friendship and service to the Crown, I want you to be the godfather."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "No time for chit-chat. We've got to get Lucita to the doctor."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "As a gesture of gratitude for your service to the Crown, I want you to be the godfather."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "No time for chit-chat. We've got to get Lucita to the doctor."

113.speaker: Narrator
113.text: I saw doubt in Lucita's eyes. Titus knelt before me.

115.speaker: Narrator
115.text: There was a touch of sadness to his smile.

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: Titus trailed a short distance behind as we walked down palace corridors towards the medical wing.

119.speaker: Lucita Azaro
119.text: "It's a good thing the Royal Council petition hearings are coming up soon. We can announce the pregnancy, then reinstate General Taddeus straight away."
119.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_RelationshipPublic"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Diplomatic"] == true) == false)

123.speaker: Lucita Azaro
123.text: "It's a good thing the Royal Council petition hearings are coming up soon. We can announce the marriage and pregnancy, then reinstate General Taddeus straight away."
123.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Diplomatic"] == true) == false)

124.speaker: Player_Romus
124.text: "I want you as my security councilor, Lucita. You're the best we've got."

125.speaker: Player_Romus
125.text: "Yes, good thinking. Your father will jump at the chance to serve."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "Your father is a disgrace to your family, Lucita. He lost us Golden Shield."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "I can't think that far into the future. Let's wait until we know more."

132.speaker: Lucita Azaro
132.text: "If I am, it's because I learned from the best."

136.speaker: Lucita Azaro
136.text: "Now that you're forming the new Wruhecist Royal Council, we don't have a reason for secrecy any more."

143.speaker: Lucita Azaro
143.text: "I have to ask, Romus. Are you sure about these reforms?"

144.speaker: Lucita Azaro
144.text: "We can announce the pregnancy right away."

145.speaker: Lucita Azaro
145.text: "We can announce the marriage and pregnancy right away."

146.speaker: Lucita Azaro
146.text: "A poor choice of words, given his condition. But you're right."

148.speaker: Lucita Azaro
148.text: "It's not *that* far into the future, Romus. The months will pass in a heartbeat."

149.speaker: Lucita Azaro
149.text: "Give him a chance to prove himself."

150.speaker: Narrator
150.text: In the medical wing, we were received immediately by a group of nurses.

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "I'm glad you don't think poorly of the decision to dissolve the Council, by the way."

153.speaker: Lucita Azaro
153.text: "I am Queen Consort. I'm above the Council now anyway."

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "I can't wait to spread the gospel of St. Wruhec with you by my side."

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "The Kingdom may be changing. But the Royal Family will be forever."

159.speaker: Narrator
159.text: Lucita was rushed into a side room that contained Rizia's most state-of-the-art blood testing technology.

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: After two interminable hours in the waiting room, the doctors called me in and told me the news.
160.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_GoldenGuard"] == true )) == false

161.speaker: Narrator
161.text: I was going to be a father again.

162.speaker: Narrator
162.text: By the end of the year, a new heir of Rizia would be born.

163.speaker: Narrator
163.text: Pabel was standing over my bed with the morning paper. He had an unusually intense expression on his face.

167.speaker: Player_Romus
167.text: "You don't need to bring me the paper. You're not my butler anymore."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "Read the paper to me in bed. The King commands you."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "Can't I sleep in a little longer?"

171.speaker: Pabel Adria
171.text: "In a bit. Let me show you something first."

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: Pabel pulled back the covers and joined me in bed. He opened the newspaper and gestured at an article.

175.speaker: Pabel Adria
175.text: "This is my copy of the Herald, thank you very much. But I wanted to show you something."

176.speaker: Narrator
176.text: Pabel sat down at the edge of the bed. He opened the newspaper and gestured at an article.

177.speaker: Pabel Adria
177.text: "I was just perusing today's Herald when I saw this."

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "Nobody cares what that old queen has to say."

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "Remind me. Why haven't I fired him yet?"

184.speaker: Player_Romus
184.text: "However bad he is, I'm sure the Voice is worse."

185.speaker: Narrator
185.text: Pabel cleared his throat and adopted an exaggerated Rumburgian accent.

189.speaker: Pabel Adria
189.text: "He's the only gossip columnist in the country. You can't deny his influence."

190.speaker: Pabel Adria
190.text: "He doesn't wield as much influence as he used to now that the press has opened up. But still..."

191.speaker: Pabel Adria
191.text: "His gossip has been harmless up to now. A useful distraction."

192.speaker: Pabel Adria
192.text: "Actually, the Voice has intelligently recognized that there are more urgent things to worry about than the King's love life."

193.speaker: Pabel Adria
193.text: "'Who *is* Lord Pabel Adria? From humble beginnings as a groundskeeper's son to head butler to the Royal Family, this man now commands both an estate in Rizia Imperii and the exclusive attention of the King himself."

197.speaker: Pabel Adria
197.text: "Since the Royal Wedding, Lord Adria has hardly strayed from His Majesty's side. They seem to share that rarest of treasures: a childhood friendship that has stretched well into middle age."

201.speaker: Pabel Adria
201.text: "Though he keeps a low profile, Lord Adria has been seen by His Majesty's side on numerous occasions. They seem to share that rarest of treasures: a childhood friendship that has stretched well into middle age."

202.speaker: Pabel Adria
202.text: "'Who *is* Pabel Adria? From humble beginnings as a groundskeeper's son to head butler to the Royal Family, this man now commands the exclusive attention of the King."

203.speaker: Pabel Adria
203.text: "His Majesty is hardly ever seen without Mr. Adria by his side. Not uncommon for a personal attendant, but these two seem to share that rarest of treasures: a childhood friendship that has stretched well into middle age."

204.speaker: Pabel Adria
204.text: "Perhaps it is the depth of that special bond which has kept our King from seeking out a new Queen Consort."

205.speaker: Pabel Adria
205.text: "Or could it be that he has already found one?"

206.speaker: Player_Romus
206.text: "I'm used to such speculations about me. But they should leave you out of this."

207.speaker: Player_Romus
207.text: "That's as bad as it gets? Ha. It's not like they can arrest us."

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "If only you could be my Queen Consort, Pabel."

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "My daughter might die, dammit! Can't a King get any privacy?"

216.speaker: Pabel Adria
216.text: "I got myself into this when I got myself into your trousers."

218.speaker: Pabel Adria
218.text: "What if we could just be out in the open about us?"

219.speaker: Player_Romus
219.text: "It's true. My daughter's a prisoner. The worst thing that could ever happen to me has already happened."

226.speaker: Pabel Adria
226.text: "You told me you're planning on letting go of your power. What's the worst that could happen?"

227.speaker: Pabel Adria
227.text: "I mean it. What's the worst that could happen?"

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "I'll be usurped. Laughed off the throne. Perhaps even from within my own family."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "You're right. I am the king. If my subjects love me, they'll love you as well."

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "Vina's got her heart set on being queen. I don't want to do anything to jeopardize that."

234.speaker: Player_Romus
234.text: "The entire world will know that the King of Rizia enjoys the company of men."

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "My daughter ran away. It's been one royal scandal after another."

236.speaker: Pabel Adria
236.text: "You'll be more famous than ever. But yes, not all of the attention will be positive."

237.speaker: Pabel Adria
237.text: "I can't imagine how much pain you've been in."

238.speaker: Pabel Adria
238.text: "Whether us going public will ease or compound that pain... I don't know, Rom. It's up to you."

239.speaker: Pabel Adria
239.text: "You being involved with a man won't disrupt the line of succession. It'd be worse if you married a woman and had a boy."

240.speaker: Pabel Adria
240.text: "It's up to you. But think of what a relief it would be to stop hiding."

242.speaker: Pabel Adria
242.text: "Let's be real. Not all of them will."

243.speaker: Pabel Adria
243.text: "Is House Toras really so intolerant? Don't answer that."

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "Let's test the waters first. We'll tell my mother."

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "This is as out in the open as I'm willing to get, Pabel. We shall continue as we have been. For the rest of our lives, if we have to."

249.speaker: Player_Romus
249.text: "I'm having Rufus Gragg fired. My love life shall remain private, and no speculation about it shall make it into the papers ever again."

252.speaker: Pabel Adria
252.text: "But we can't go on forever like this. Sooner or later, the truth will out."

253.speaker: Narrator
253.text: He got up and smoothed out his suit.

257.speaker: Pabel Adria
257.text: "If you'll excuse me, I have an estate that needs tending to."

258.speaker: Pabel Adria
258.text: "If you'll excuse me, I have chores that need tending to."

264.speaker: Pabel Adria
264.text: "After our conversation at Vina's wedding, Madam Estela definitely suspects something."

265.speaker: Pabel Adria
265.text: "The Queen Mother doesn't miss a thing that goes on in this palace. She must suspect something already."

266.speaker: Narrator
266.text: We left my chambers and crossed the hall. I knocked on my mother's door.

267.speaker: Narrator
267.text: She answered, still in her bathrobe.

268.speaker: Estela Toras
268.text: "My goodness, son. What are you two doing here?"

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "Pabel and I have something to tell you."

271.speaker: Player_Romus
271.text: "Let's go to the balcony. I could use a smoke."

272.speaker: Narrator
272.text: We entered the room and sat on opposite sofas.

274.speaker: Narrator
274.text: We crossed the room and went onto the balcony. Mother lit a cigarette and handed it to me.

275.speaker: Estela Toras
275.text: "Now. What is so urgent that you'd disturb an old lady's birthday preparations?"

277.speaker: Player_Romus
277.text: "Pabel and I are in love. We have been for a long time."

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "This might come as a shock, but I am attracted to men as well as women."

282.speaker: Player_Romus
282.text: "I risk bringing shame upon this family by loving a member of the same sex."

283.speaker: Narrator
283.text: My mother was very quiet for a long moment.

285.speaker: Estela Toras
285.text: "Oh, darling. I know. I'm your mother, after all."

286.speaker: Estela Toras
286.text: "The question remains, though. What exactly do you plan to do about it?"

287.speaker: Estela Toras
287.text: "I've been waiting for this news since you rolled out the rainbow carpet to homosexuals across the kingdom."

288.speaker: Narrator
288.text: Pabel gave a smile of relief.

289.speaker: Player_Romus
289.text: "I want the world to know. We could set an example for millions."

291.speaker: Player_Romus
291.text: "Sooner or later, everyone will find out. I should control the narrative by making an announcement."

294.speaker: Estela Toras
294.text: "I didn't fully know what I was signing up for when I married into House Toras. But I know now."

295.speaker: Estela Toras
295.text: "A husband poisoned by a religious lunatic..."

300.speaker: Estela Toras
300.text: "A precious daughter-in-law taken before her time..."

302.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
302.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == false)

303.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
303.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == false)) == false

304.speaker: Estela Toras
304.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == false)

305.speaker: Estela Toras
305.text: "His father humiliated to the point of resignation..."

312.speaker: Estela Toras
312.text: "A granddaughter held hostage in a war that should never have happened in the first place..."
312.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == false)) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true) == false)

313.speaker: Estela Toras
313.text: "A granddaughter made miserable to the point of self-exile..."
313.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == false)) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true) == false)

317.speaker: Narrator
317.text: She pulled out a handkerchief and dabbed at her eyes.
317.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == false)) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true) == false)

318.speaker: Estela Toras
318.text: "I love you, darling. But you can't bring more shame to this family. Especially not right before my birthday."

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: "I'm surprised at you, Mother. I thought you'd support me."

321.speaker: Player_Romus
321.text: "I am sorry. But none of this was my fault."

322.speaker: Player_Romus
322.text: "You started it! You seduced my father and brought our noble house to ruin."

325.speaker: Estela Toras
325.text: "That makes no difference. You carry the weight of your entire House on your shoulders."

327.speaker: Estela Toras
327.text: "If you want to live openly with your charming companion here, by all means, do so."

328.speaker: Estela Toras
328.text: "I do support you. This is for your own good."

329.speaker: Estela Toras
329.text: "Just... not with the crown on your head. Please."

330.speaker: Estela Toras
330.text: "Abdicate and live your truth. Or stay in power and hide it. That's my advice."

331.speaker: Narrator
331.text: Pabel and I looked at each other, then at my mother once more.

332.speaker: Player_Romus
332.text: "If I have to leave the throne to be with the man I love, I will. My work as King is not yet over, but I will take your advice seriously."

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: "Your true colors are showing. I refuse to give in to your bigotry. We will announce our love to the world."

334.speaker: Player_Romus
334.text: "You have made your point. As long as I am king, this will be our secret."

340.speaker: Estela Toras
340.text: "Now, Lord Adria. Don't you have an estate to attend to?"

341.speaker: Estela Toras
341.text: "Now, Mr. Adria. Don't you have chores to attend to?"

344.speaker: Estela Toras
344.text: "But I won't be the one to stop you."

348.speaker: Narrator
348.text: She swiftly ushered us both out the door and closed it without another word.

349.speaker: Estela Toras
349.text: "If you'll excuse me, I've got to put my face on before breakfast."

353.speaker: Estela Toras
353.text: "To add insult to injury, we lost Zille. If I may say so, dear... you had one job!"
353.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == false)) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true) == false)

359.speaker: Player_Romus
359.text: "Did Bruno kick you out of bed again? Sorry, he does that."

360.speaker: Player_Romus
360.text: "One moment. Bruno! You're going to be a big brother!"

364.speaker: Narrator
364.text: My dog hopped on the bed and licked my face. Lucita scratched him behind the ears, then tugged my arm impatiently.

369.speaker: Titus Gordion
369.text: "This explains a lot. Congratulations, my king."

373.speaker: Narrator
373.text: Bruno hopped on the bed and licked Pabel's face. He sighed wistfully.

375.speaker: Pabel Adria
375.text: "So that's it? After everything, you would really step down for me?"

378.speaker: Narrator
378.text: Pabel and I stood facing each other in the hallway.

382.speaker: Player_Romus
382.text: "If my reforms succeed, my power will be symbolic. Why not live out the rest of my days in peace?"

386.speaker: Player_Romus
386.text: "I've accomplished what I set out to do. Things can only go downhill from here."
386.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Won"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_Rizia_Unification"] == true

388.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
388.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Won"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_Rizia_Unification"] == true

389.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
389.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Won"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_Rizia_Unification"] == true) == false

390.speaker: Player_Romus
390.text: "I have failed my kingdom anyway. I don't deserve my crown."
390.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Won"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_Rizia_Unification"] == true) == false

391.speaker: Player_Romus
391.text: "It will be a relief, to be honest. Being king is hard."

392.speaker: Player_Romus
392.text: "I'm thinking about it. No promises yet."

398.speaker: Pabel Adria
398.text: "Madam Estela was right. I should be going."

399.speaker: Narrator
399.text: He rapidly turned away from me and walked down the hall.

400.speaker: Player_Romus
400.text: "Homosexuality is legal. You're a lord. There's nothing stopping us."

404.speaker: Player_Romus
404.text: "Homosexuality is legal. There's nothing stopping us."

405.speaker: Player_Romus
405.text: "Screw what my mother says. I refuse to be ashamed of my identity."

406.speaker: Player_Romus
406.text: "I'd rather not. But everyone will find out sooner or later. It's best to control the narrative."

412.speaker: Pabel Adria
412.text: "Having served two of you, I won't argue with that."

414.speaker: Pabel Adria
414.text: "I still wish Rizia were ready to be ruled by a King and a King Consort. But realistically... your mother has a point."

415.speaker: Narrator
415.text: He placed his hand in mine and we walked back down the hall together.

416.speaker: Narrator
416.text: I thought about Mother's words. Perhaps the time would have to come for me to end my reign.

418.speaker: Pabel Adria
418.text: "Shall we leak the news to Rufus Gragg? If anyone deserves the scoop, he does."

423.speaker: Narrator
423.text: Bruno hopped off the bed as Pabel sat down. He opened the newspaper and gestured at an article.

427.speaker: Narrator
427.text: Pabel gently shoved Bruno aside, pulled back the covers and joined me in bed. He opened the newspaper and gestured at an article.

432.speaker: Player_Romus
432.text: "I know your religion despises homosexuality. But can't you make an exception for your son?"

434.speaker: Estela Toras
434.text: "My religion -- whatever it may be -- has nothing to do with what I'm saying."

435.speaker: Player_Romus
435.text: "I suspect my reign won't last much longer anyway. Might as well go out with a bang."
435.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction"] == true) == false)

439.speaker: Pabel Adria
439.text: "I don't know what you're thinking, but I draw the line at doing *that* in public."

443.speaker: Player_Romus
443.text: "No. In fact, I want him fired for smearing my good name. Let's tell the main staff at the Herald."

444.speaker: Player_Romus
444.text: "No, let's give this to the Voice. That'll teach him for being such a busybody."

447.speaker: Pabel Adria
447.text: "If we're lucky, it'll make the front page."

448.speaker: Narrator
448.text: He placed his hand in mine. We walked back down the hall together.

471.speaker: Player_Romus
471.text: "There is still no word about Vina. I may have to make the call at one point."

480.speaker: Estela Toras
480.text: "His father found guilty of poisoning his own brother -- my husband..."

481.speaker: Estela Toras
481.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == false)) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true)

485.speaker: Player_Romus
485.text: "I love you, Pabel. But I love being king more."

486.speaker: Player_Romus
486.text: "Just give it a few more years. The public will be ready for us someday."

487.speaker: Player_Romus
487.text: "You shouldn't be with me anymore, Pabel. Go meet someone else. Be free."

488.speaker: Player_Romus
488.text: "You heard my mother. My family has been through enough."

492.speaker: Player_Romus
492.text: "Are you sure you don't want to wait until after Mother's birthday?"

494.speaker: Lucita Azaro
494.text: "That's what you're concerned about? Come on, let's go."

499.speaker: Lucita Azaro
499.text: "My family is reluctant enough to give up our power. If they know they've got a potential heir on the throne..."

500.speaker: Player_Romus
500.text: "The monarchy's barely changing under the new constitution. The Azaros and everyone else have nothing to worry about."

504.speaker: Player_Romus
504.text: "But you'll convince them reform is the right way to go. Yes?"

505.speaker: Player_Romus
505.text: "The royal baby will be a Toras, anyway. Not an Azaro."

506.speaker: Lucita Azaro
506.text: "In name only. I'll teach him to swordfight before he can even walk."

507.speaker: Lucita Azaro
507.text: "I'll try my best. But not if the reforms go directly against their interests. You have to understand that."

508.speaker: Lucita Azaro
508.text: "My father will have to be the judge of that."

509.speaker: Player_Romus
509.text: "If they're truly concerned for the safety of their unborn heir, they'll agree to these changes."

512.speaker: Player_Romus
512.text: "The Rizian Royal Family shall still reign, my dear. The Azaros will be lucky to be part of it."

513.speaker: Lucita Azaro
513.text: "My father's going to want more than that. And I'm not sure he can be convinced otherwise."

517.speaker: Lucita Azaro
517.text: "And you've been disappearing off God knows where..."

521.speaker: Player_Romus
521.text: "With everything that's been going on, you'd think he'd give it a rest."

522.speaker: Pabel Adria
522.text: "Gossip is a welcome distraction from times of turmoil. I get it. But listen..."

523.speaker: Player_Romus
523.text: "It gladdens my heart that so many Rizians like us are now able to live freely. But it's never going to be us, Pabel. Not as long as I am King."

524.speaker: Narrator
524.text: He looked at me for a moment, crestfallen, then embraced me tightly.

526.speaker: Pabel Adria
526.text: "But you're right. You're a royal. Your life is not entirely yours to lead."

527.speaker: Player_Romus
527.text: "It isn't. But I still want to share it with you."

528.speaker: Player_Romus
528.text: "I may not rule Rizia forever. 'Someday' could come sooner than you think."

529.speaker: Pabel Adria
529.text: "Rom. I could never ask you to give up the throne for me."

533.speaker: Player_Romus
533.text: "What about your life? You deserve to be with someone who can show you off like the jewel you are."

534.speaker: Pabel Adria
534.text: "Touching, Rom. But I can't give you up that easily."

538.speaker: Narrator
538.text: He pulled back and traced the scar on my chest with his fingers.

539.speaker: Narrator
539.text: He pulled back and traced my bare collarbone with his fingers.

543.speaker: Pabel Adria
543.text: "I'll see you at the Queen Mother's birthday. As an esteemed guest, of course."

544.speaker: Pabel Adria
544.text: "I should get going. Lots to do before the Queen Mother's birthday."

545.speaker: Narrator
545.text: He kissed me, bowed and walked out.

546.speaker: Player_Romus
546.text: "What do you think we should do?"

547.speaker: Player_Romus
547.text: "I'm sorry, Mother. But I can't keep hiding who I am. The birthday party will be our debut as a couple."

549.speaker: Narrator
549.text: He smiled sadly and kissed me on the cheek.

550.speaker: Pabel Adria
550.text: "I've waited this long. A few more years won't hurt."

551.speaker: Narrator
551.text: He smiled sadly and kissed me on the cheek.

552.speaker: Pabel Adria
552.text: "You say that as if loving you were a choice."

556.speaker: Pabel Adria
556.text: "I'll see you at the Queen Mother's birthday. As an esteemed guest, of course."

557.speaker: Pabel Adria
557.text: "I should get going. Lots to do before the Queen Mother's birthday."

558.speaker: Narrator
558.text: He kissed me again, bowed and walked away.

571.speaker: Player_Romus
571.text: "Trust me. After my mother's birthday party, nobody will be talking about our relationship anymore."

572.speaker: Pabel Adria
572.text: "I don't know if I like the sound of that... But all right."

577.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
577.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_GoldenGuard"] == true )) == false

578.speaker: Narrator
578.text: As I was waiting for her to re-emerge, Titus whispered in my ear.

579.speaker: Titus Gordion
579.text: "Your Majesty, do you still want to go through with the plans we talked about? As it stands, you would be putting the Queen Consort -- and your own unborn child -- in great danger."

580.speaker: Player_Romus
580.text: "I know, but I have no choice. We're doing this."

581.speaker: Player_Romus
581.text: "You're right. We won't strike against House Azaro that night."

585.speaker: Player_Romus
585.text: "I will make sure nothing happens to either of them."

586.speaker: Player_Romus
586.text: "You're right. Let's call off the plan. It's too risky."

589.speaker: Titus Gordion
589.text: "I suppose even in her condition, Lucita is more than capable of protecting herself."

592.speaker: Narrator
592.text: Titus gave a furtive sigh of relief.

595.speaker: Narrator
595.text: Bruno trailed a short distance behind as we walked down palace corridors towards the medical wing.

596.speaker: Narrator
596.text: Pabel trailed a short distance behind as we walked down palace corridors towards the medical wing.

597.speaker: Narrator
597.text: We walked down palace corridors towards the medical wing.
